technicalInputs: Original OpenPencil documentation and pinned tools/openpencil dependencies
independenceLimit: Separate conversation contexts with access instructions; no separate filesystem sandbox, no statistical model-independence claim.
comparison: Definition conformity first; then semantic/component-level differences. Free page layout, generated IDs and bytewise file identity are not required to match.
reviewPrerequisites: Reviewer derives and saves criteria from definition before reading builder outputs; actual comparison only after both builders finish.
inputFreeze: Hashes recomputed independently from components/ at run start; revision derived as sha256 over compact, key-sorted path->sha256 JSON.

interruptions.effect: No files written. The session had read the definition and analysed the pinned toolchain and layout arithmetic.
interruptions.recovery: Resumed in the same session with its own prior reasoning; no input from builder-a or prior runs.

interruptions.effect: Session ended without a message. Six of seven deliverables plus an unrequested intermediate render-report.json existed; REPORT.md missing.
interruptions.recovery: Resumed in the same session; REPORT.md written, render-report.json removed, generate.mjs rerun so checks.json matches the delivered file.

interruptionImpact: All interruptions were harness step limits, not access to forbidden inputs. Each builder resumed in its own session, so its own prior reasoning persisted; no builder saw the other builder, run-01, prior outputs or review artifacts. The run therefore remains a two-context comparison, but it is not a claim of uninterrupted single-shot generation. The reviewer is informed of these interruptions as coordination metadata; they must be recorded in the review result and its limitations.
